<!--
  PMS 1.43.4.10903 GET /library/sections/{key}/all?includeGuids=1&title=free with the headers
  X-Plex-Container-Start=0 and X-Plex-Container-Size=5, which is what plexapi's
  LibrarySection.search(title="free", maxresults=5) issues. Recorded 2026-10-02, read-only, off a real
  server's Movies library (10,030 films) for the season editor's film search (issue #137).
  File paths are neutralised, and so is one Shortlist row's title (see below); everything else is verbatim.

  What it settles:
  - `title=` is a SUBSTRING match, not a prefix or whole-title one: "free" finds Free Burma Rangers and
    Free Guy alike. totalSize is 21; the container headers cut the page to 5.
  - Every result carries its <Guid id="tmdb://..."> inline.
  - A result lists Shortlist's own rows among its <Collection tag> children, per-account title marker
    included (as &#8203; / &#8204; entities). Free Guy's named the person and a film they watched, so it
    is replaced by a neutral title with an all-zero marker.
-->
